scope: Independent CPU component review; no model, Ray, GPU or performance qualification

initial_findings.issue: Idle child EOF could accept new work after the I/O thread exited
initial_findings.resolution: Reject dead child/completed I/O under the ownership lock and mark transport unavailable without overwriting known receipts

initial_findings.issue: Expired input or a deadline crossed during non-yielding rendering could still spend model-call budget
initial_findings.resolution: Check actual monotonic deadline at entry and immediately before native generation

initial_findings.issue: Native generate cancellation could await a stalled abort and prevent deadline notification
initial_findings.resolution: Bound generation tasks by held requests; notify unknown independently while retaining task and input ownership

initial_findings.issue: Compact receipt preflight underestimated actual fields; unobserved run-task exceptions could lose terminal notification
initial_findings.resolution: Reserve worst-case shared receipt metadata before acceptance and observe request task failure through one fault future

standards.additional_evidence: A CPU generation task that repeatedly swallowed cancellation still produced deadline unknown. close(0.03) returned unknown in approximately 0.031s with pending_request_tasks=1; after releasing the fixture a later close reported 0 pending tasks.
standards.conclusion: Original EOF and expired-budget issues fixed; task retention is bounded; no new lifecycle or scoped-close regression found. GPU and descendant exit are not claimed.

spec.outcome: PASS; no remaining required fix found
spec.additional_evidence: Original CPU reproducers now reject an idle-dead child, reject the 4096-byte compact-receipt boundary identity before handoff with held=0, and notify unknown at deadline while cancellation cleanup remains owned.
spec.conclusion: All three original substantive findings closed. Real vLLM/GPU, model descendant exit and actor/Core integration remain pending.

provenance: Reviewer terminal summaries transcribed from collaboration messages. Full transient reviewer debug logs were not archived; these summaries do not replace the retained parent regression log.
